docs.title: Scheduler User Guide
docs.text: Welcome to the comprehensive Scheduler setup and user guide. This documentation will walk you through the complete process of setting up and using the Scheduler system.

docs.title: What is Scheduler?
docs.text:
The Scheduler is a comprehensive appointment booking and management system designed for businesses that need to coordinate staff, resources, and customer appointments efficiently. Whether you run a clinic, salon, consulting firm, or any service-based business, Scheduler helps you:

📅 Manage Appointments: Book, schedule, and track customer appointments with ease

👥 Staff Coordination: Assign staff members, manage schedules, and track availability

🏢 Multi-Branch Support: Handle multiple locations with different operating hours and resources

🔧 Resource Management: Track rooms, equipment, and other resources needed for services

📊 Smart Booking: Automatically find available time slots based on staff schedules and resource availability

📱 Outlook Integration: Sync appointments with Microsoft Outlook for seamless calendar management

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
✅ Prerequisites: Before you begin, ensure you have completed the Pre-criteria requirements:

  • Tenant has been set up (CRS)
  • At least 1 Branch has been created
  • Admin can login to the admin portal

docs.title: 📋 Setup Flow
docs.text:
Follow these steps in order for a complete scheduler setup:

  • Pre-criteria
  • Rooms & Equipment
  • Specialization & Skills
  • Branch Hours
  • Shift Templates
  • Branch Rooms
  • Branch Equipment
  • Service Categories
  • Services
  • Staff
  • Schedules

docs.title: Outlook Integration
docs.text:
Sync appointments with Outlook calendars

  • Tenant Integration

  • Staff Integration

docs.title: Create Appointments
docs.text:
Book and manage appointments

Book Appointments

docs.title: Create Appointment
docs.text: This guide will walk you through creating appointments in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Creating appointments allows you to book services for customers with specific staff members at designated times. The system will automatically check availability and resource requirements.

docs.title: How Smart Booking Works
docs.text: The scheduler system uses intelligent logic to ensure smooth appointment booking:

docs.title: Smart Resource Management
docs.text:
• Service Requirements: Automatically checks what room types and equipment are needed for your selected services
  • Resource Filtering: Excludes inactive rooms and equipment from availability
  • Staff Qualification: Only shows staff members who are qualified for your selected services or desired staff name if client provide it

docs.title: Intelligent Scheduling
docs.text:
• Availability Check: Verifies staff schedules and branch operating hours on the booking date
  • Conflict Prevention: Automatically prevents double-booking of staff or rooms
  • Break Time Respect: Excludes branch and staff breaks as well as personal time off from available slots

docs.title: Smart Staff Assignment
docs.text:
• Workload Balancing: If you don't specify a staff member, the system chooses the one with the lightest workload
  • Fair Distribution: Ensures even workload distribution across all staff members

docs.title: Room Optimization
docs.text:
• Service-Based Selection: Uses the room types you specified when creating the service
  • Availability Priority: Tries the first preferred room type, then the second, and so on
  • Compatibility Check: Only assigns rooms that meet all service requirements

docs.title: What This Means for You
docs.text:
When you book an appointment, you can trust that:

✅ The time slot is genuinely available

✅ Your preferred staff member will be there (if available)

✅ All required resources are ready

✅ No scheduling conflicts will occur

✅ The system has found the most efficient option

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Appointments
docs.text: • In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Appointments

docs.title: Step 2: Start Appointment Creation
docs.text:
• Click Create Appointment button, or
  • Click on a time slot in the calendar view to start creating an appointment

docs.title: Step 3: Select Customer
docs.text:
• Select Existing Customer: Choose from the dropdown list of existing customers
  • Add New Customer: Click Add New Customer to create a new customer record
    • Fill in customer details (name, email, phone, etc.)
    • Click Save to add the new customer
    • You can also create customers on the Customers page

docs.title: Step 4: Select Service Details
docs.text:
• Select Branch: Choose which branch the appointment will take place at
  • Select Service Category: Choose the appropriate service category
  • Select Service: Choose the specific service to be provided

docs.title: Step 5: Assign Staff (Optional)
docs.text:
• Select Staff/Counsellor: Choose a specific staff member for the appointment
    • This is optional - the system can auto-assign based on availability
    • Only staff members qualified for the selected service will be available

docs.title: Step 6: Assign Room or Equipment (Optional)
docs.text:
• Select room/equipment: Choose a specific room/equipment by toggle the button
    • This is optional - the system can auto-assign based on availability

docs.title: Step 7: Set Date and Time
docs.text:
• Select Date: Choose the appointment date from the calendar
  • Select Time Slot: Choose an available time slot
    • Available slots are shown based on:
      • Branch operating hours
      • Staff availability
      • Room and equipment availability
      • Existing appointments

docs.title: Step 8: Create Appointment
docs.text:
• Review all appointment details
  • Click Create to confirm the appointment

docs.title: Customer Selection
docs.text:
• Existing Customers: Choose from previously created customer records
  • New Customers: Create customer records with complete contact information
  • Customer Information: Ensure accurate contact details for notifications

docs.title: Service Configuration
docs.text:
• Branch Selection: Choose the appropriate location
  • Service Category: Select the broad category of service
  • Service Selection: Choose the specific service to be provided
  • Service Requirements: System automatically checks room and equipment needs

docs.title: Staff Assignment
docs.text:
• Optional Assignment: Staff can be assigned or left for auto-assignment
  • Qualification Check: Only staff qualified for the service are available
  • Availability Check: System shows only available staff members

docs.title: Scheduling
docs.text:
• Date Selection: Choose from available dates
  • Time Slots: Available slots are automatically calculated
  • Conflict Prevention: System prevents double-booking

docs.title: 📹 Video Tutorial
docs.text: Follow along in this short video to see exactly how it's done!

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Appointments menu: Ensure you have appropriate permissions to create appointments.

No available time slots: Check branch operating hours and staff schedules.

Service not available: Verify service is available at the selected branch.

Staff not available: Check staff schedules and qualifications.

Customer not found: Create new customer or check existing customer records.

Appointment not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and try again.

docs.title: Outlook Integration (Staff)
docs.text: This guide will walk you through setting up Outlook integration for individual staff members, allowing them to sync their assigned appointments with their personal Outlook calendars.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Staff-level Outlook integration enables:

  • Individual staff members to sync their assigned appointments
  • Personal calendar management for each staff member
  • Automatic updates when appointments are assigned or modified

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Staff Management
docs.text:
• In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Staffs → Staffs
  • Click Edit on the staff member you want to set up Outlook integration for

docs.title: Step 2: Send Authentication URL
docs.text:
• In the staff member's profile, locate the Outlook Integration section
  • Click Send Authentication URL

docs.title: Step 3: Staff Authentication Process
docs.text:
• An authentication URL will be sent to the staff member's email address
  • The staff member needs to:
    • Check their email for the authentication URL
    • Click on the URL to open the authentication page
    • Sign in with their Microsoft account
    • Grant necessary permissions for calendar access
    • Confirm the integration request

docs.title: Personal Calendar Management
docs.text:
• Staff can view their appointments in their personal calendar
  • Integration with existing Outlook workflow
  • Reduced need to check multiple systems

docs.title: Real-time Updates
docs.text:
• Automatic sync of appointment assignments
  • Immediate updates in personal Outlook calendar
  • Consistent information across systems

docs.title: Individual Control
docs.text:
• Each staff member controls their own integration
  • Personal calendar privacy maintained
  • Flexible integration management

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up staff Outlook integration, you can: Create Appointments - Start booking appointments

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Staffs menu: Ensure you have admin permissions to access staff management.

Authentication URL not sent: Check staff member's email address and try again.

Staff cannot access URL: Ensure staff member has access to their email and Microsoft account.

Sync not working: Verify staff member completed authentication and try reconnecting.

Missing appointments: Check that appointments are properly assigned to the staff member.

Permission errors: Ensure staff member's Microsoft account has appropriate calendar access permissions.

docs.title: Outlook Integration (Tenant)
docs.text: This guide will walk you through setting up Outlook integration for the tenant, allowing all appointments to be synced with the tenant's Outlook calendar.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Tenant-level Outlook integration enables:

  • Automatic sync of all appointments to the tenant's Outlook calendar
  • Real-time updates when appointments are created, modified, or cancelled
  • Centralized calendar management for the organization

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Integrations
docs.text:
• In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Integrations
  • Click Edit on the Outlook integration option

docs.title: Step 2: Connect Outlook
docs.text:
• Click Connect Outlook
  • You will be redirected to Microsoft Outlook authentication page

docs.title: Step 3: Complete Authentication
docs.text:
• Sign in with your Microsoft account
  • Grant necessary permissions for calendar access
  • Confirm the integration request

docs.title: Appointment Details
docs.text:
• Appointment date and time
  • Customer information
  • Service details
  • Staff member assigned
  • Branch location
  • Appointment status (confirmed, cancelled, completed)

docs.title: Calendar Events
docs.text:
• All appointments appear as calendar events
  • Events include all relevant appointment details
  • Real-time updates when appointments change

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
After setting up tenant Outlook integration, you can also set up:

  • Outlook Integration (Staff) - For individual staff member sync
  • Create Appointments - Start booking appointments

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Integrations menu: Ensure you have admin permissions to access integration settings.

Authentication fails: Check your Microsoft account credentials and permissions.

Sync not working: Verify internet connection and try reconnecting Outlook.

Missing appointments: Check that appointments are being created properly in the scheduler system.

Permission errors: Ensure the Microsoft account has appropriate calendar access permissions.

docs.title: Setup Branch Equipment
docs.text: This guide will walk you through adding equipment to your branch in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Branch equipment represents the physical resources available in your branch. Each equipment item must be assigned an equipment type that was previously created in the Rooms & Equipment settings.

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Branch Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Branch

docs.title: Step 2: Select Branch
docs.text: Click to view the branch

docs.title: Step 3: Access Equipment Section
docs.text:
• In the branch view, locate the Equipments section
  • Click Create Equipment

docs.title: Step 4: Input Equipment Details
docs.text:
• Name: Enter a descriptive name for the equipment
  • Description (Optional): Enter a description of the equipment's features or specifications
  • Photo (Optional): Upload a photo of the equipment
  • Equipment Type: Select the appropriate equipment type from the dropdown (created in previous setup)
  • Quantity: Set the quantity (you can leave this as 1 for individual items)

docs.title: Step 5: Save Equipment
docs.text:
• Click Create to add the equipment
  • Make sure to click the Save button in the bottom right corner

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up branch equipment, proceed to: Setup Service Category

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Equipments section: Ensure you're in the correct branch view and have admin permissions.

No equipment types available: Complete the Rooms & Equipment setup first.

Equipment not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and click the main "Save" button after creating equipment.

docs.title: Setup Branch Operating Hours
docs.text: This guide will walk you through setting up the operating hours for your branch in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Branch operating hours define when your branch is open for business. These hours are used to:

  • Determine available appointment slots
  • Set staff availability windows
  • Control when services can be booked

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Branch Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Branch

docs.title: Step 2: Select Branch
docs.text: Click to view the branch

docs.title: Step 3: Set Operating Hours
docs.text: In the Operating Hours section, you need to setup the operating hours for each day from Monday to Sunday

docs.title: Step 4: Set Daily Hours
docs.text:
• Click on each Day (Monday through Sunday)
  • Use the time slider to set the opening and closing times for each day
  • You can set different hours for each day of the week
  • Click Save Changes after setting hours for each day

docs.title: Step 5: Save All Changes
docs.text: After setting up hours for all days, make sure to click the Save button in the bottom right corner

docs.title: Setting Opening Time
docs.text:
• Drag the left handle of the time slider to set when the branch opens
  • The time will be displayed as you drag

docs.title: Setting Closing Time
docs.text:
• Drag the right handle of the time slider to set when the branch closes
  • Ensure closing time is after opening time

docs.title: Closed Days
docs.text:
• To set a day as closed, click the time slider and deactivate that day
  • Click Save Changes after setting

docs.title: 📹 Video Tutorial
docs.text: Follow along in this short video to see exactly how it's done!

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up branch operating hours, proceed to: Setup Staff Shift Template

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Time slider not responding: Try refreshing the page and ensure you have admin permissions.

Cannot save changes: Verify that closing time is after opening time for each day.

Hours not displaying correctly: Check that you've clicked "Save Changes" for each day and the main "Save" button.

Multiple branches: Repeat this process for each branch that needs different operating hours.

docs.title: Setup Branch Room
docs.text: This guide will walk you through adding rooms to your branch in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Branch rooms are the physical spaces where appointments take place. Each room must be assigned a room type that was previously created in the Rooms & Equipment settings.

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Branch Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Branch

docs.title: Step 2: Select Branch
docs.text: Click to view the branch

docs.title: Step 3: Access Rooms Section
docs.text:
• In the branch view, locate the Rooms section
  • Click Create Room

docs.title: Step 4: Input Room Details
docs.text:
• Name: Enter a descriptive name for the room
  • Description (Optional): Enter a description of the room's features or purpose
  • Room Type: Select the appropriate room type from the dropdown (created in previous setup)

docs.title: Step 5: Save Room
docs.text:
• Click Create to add the room
  • Make sure to click the Save button in the bottom right corner

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up branch rooms, proceed to: Setup Branch Equipment

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Rooms section: Ensure you're in the correct branch view and have admin permissions.

No room types available: Complete the Rooms & Equipment setup first.

Room not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and click the main "Save" button after creating rooms.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Before setting up the Scheduler system, ensure the following prerequisites are met. This step is crucial for a successful setup process.

docs.title: ✅ Required Prerequisites
docs.text:
1. Tenant Setup (CRS): The tenant must already be set up

2. Branch Creation: At least one branch must already be created in the system

3. Admin Access: Admin user must be able to log in to the admin portal

docs.title: 🚀 Next Steps
docs.text: Once all prerequisites are verified, proceed with the scheduler setup.

docs.title: Setup Rooms & Equipment Types
docs.text: This guide will walk you through setting up room and equipment types in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Room and equipment types are templates that define the categories of rooms and equipment available in your system. These types are used when creating actual rooms and equipment for specific branches.

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Rooms & Equipments

docs.title: Step 2: Select Rooms Tab
docs.text: Click on the Rooms tab below the main menu

docs.title: Step 3: Create Room Type
docs.text:
• Name: Enter a descriptive name for the room type
  • Description (Optional): Enter a description explaining the room type's purpose
  • Click Create

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Rooms & Equipment

docs.title: Step 2: Select Equipment Tab
docs.text: Click on the Equipment tab below the main menu

docs.title: Step 3: Create Equipment Type
docs.text: Click Create button and fill in the following information: - Name: Enter a descriptive name for the equipment type - Description(Optional): Enter a description explaining the equipment type's purpose - Click Create

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
After setting up room and equipment types, proceed to:

  • Setup Specialization & Skills (Optional)
  • Setup Branch Operating Hours

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Rooms & Equipment menu: Ensure you have admin permissions to access settings.

Save button not working: Check that all required fields are filled and try again.

docs.title: Setup Service Category
docs.text: This guide will walk you through creating service categories to organize your services in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Service categories help customers to find the services they need and for staff to manage service offerings.

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Services
docs.text:
• In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Services → Category
  • Click Create Categories

docs.title: Step 2: Input Category Details
docs.text:
• Name: Enter a descriptive name for the service category
  • Description (Optional): Enter a description explaining what services fall under this category

docs.title: Step 3: Save Category
docs.text: • Click Create to add the category

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up service categories, proceed to: Setup Service

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Services menu: Ensure you have admin permissions to access services configuration.

Category not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and try again.

docs.title: Setup Service
docs.text: This guide will walk you through creating services in the scheduler system. Services define what appointments can be booked and what resources are required.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Services are the bookable offerings in your scheduler system. Each service defines:

  • What the service is
  • How long it takes
  • What it costs
  • What resources are needed

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Services
docs.text:
• In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Services → Services
  • Click Create Service

docs.title: Step 2: Input Basic Service Details
docs.text:
• Service Name: Enter a clear, descriptive name for the service
  • Category: Select the appropriate service category from the dropdown (created in previous setup)
  • Base Price: Set the base price for this service
  • Duration: Set how long the service takes (in minutes)
  • Description (Optional): Enter a description of what the service includes
  • Image (Optional): Upload an image representing the service

docs.title: Step 3: Resource Requirements and Branch Availability
docs.text:
• Toggle Rooms: Enable this if the service requires a specific room type
    • Select which room type is needed for this service
  • Toggle Equipment: Enable this if the service requires specific equipment
    • Select which equipment type is needed for this service
  • Select Branch Availability: Choose which branch(es) this service is available in
    • Select specific branches or leave as "All branches"

docs.title: Step 4: Skip Advanced Settings
docs.text:
• Disregard Pricing Rules: Leave this section for now
  • Disregard Cancellation Policy: Leave this section for now

docs.title: Step 5: Save Service
docs.text: • Click Create Service to save the service

docs.title: 📹 Video Tutorial
docs.text: Follow along in this short video to see exactly how it's done!

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up services, proceed to: Setup Staff / Counsellors

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Services menu: Ensure you have admin permissions to access services configuration.

Service not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and try again.

No categories available: Complete the Service Category setup first.

No room/equipment types available: Complete the Rooms & Equipment setup first.

docs.title: Setup Specialization & Skills (Optional)
docs.text: This guide covers the optional setup of specializations and skills for staff members in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Specializations and skills allow you to categorize staff members based on their expertise and capabilities. This helps in:

  • Matching staff to appropriate services
  • Filtering staff availability based on service requirements
  • Organizing staff by their areas of expertise

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Specialization & Skills

docs.title: Step 2: Select Specialization Tab
docs.text: Click on the Specialization tab below the main menu

docs.title: Step 3: Create Specialization
docs.text:
• Name: Enter a descriptive name for the specialization
  • Description (Optional): Enter a description explaining the specialization
  • Click Create Specialization

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Specialization & Skills

docs.title: Step 2: Select Skills Tab
docs.text: Click on the Skills tab below the main menu

docs.title: Step 3: Create Skill
docs.text:
• Name: Enter a descriptive name for the skill
  • Description (Optional): Enter a description explaining the skill
  • Click Create Skill

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up specializations and skills (or skipping this step), proceed to: Setup Branch Operating Hours

docs.title: Setup Staff Schedules / Rosters
docs.text: This guide will walk you through creating staff schedules and rosters in the scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Staff schedules define when staff members are available to provide services. These schedules can be created for individual staff or multiple staff members at once, and can be repeated over multiple weeks.

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Staff Schedules
docs.text:
• In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Staffs → Schedules
  • Click Add Schedule

docs.title: Step 2: Select Staff Members
docs.text: • Select the staff members you want to create schedules for. You can select multiple staff members at once

docs.title: Step 3: Schedule Details
docs.text:
• Select Branch: Choose the branch for this schedule
  • Select Shift Template: For each day of the week, select the appropriate shift template (use the shift templates created in previous setup)

docs.title: Step 4: Copy Schedule Pattern
docs.text:
• Set First Day: Set the schedule for Monday (or first day of your work week)
  • Copy to All Days: Click this button to apply the same schedule to all days of the week
  • Toggle Repeat: Enable this to set how many weeks the schedule should be repeated

docs.title: Step 5: Save Schedule
docs.text: • Click Add Schedule to create the schedule

docs.title: 📹 Video Tutorial
docs.text: Follow along in this short video to see exactly how it's done!

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
After setting up staff schedules, you can proceed to:

  • Outlook Integration (Tenant) - Sync appointments with tenant Outlook
  • Outlook Integration (Staff) - Sync staff appointments with Outlook
  • Create Appointments - Start booking appointments

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Schedules menu: Ensure you have admin permissions to access staff scheduling.

No staff members available: Complete the Staff setup first.

No shift templates available: Complete the Staff Shift Template setup first.

Schedule not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and try again.

Conflicting schedules: Ensure staff members don't have overlapping schedules for the same time period.

Template mismatch: Ensure shift templates are compatible with branch operating hours.

docs.title: Setup Staff Shift Template
docs.text: This guide will walk you through creating staff shift templates that define standard working patterns for your staff members.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Staff shift templates are predefined work schedules that can be applied to staff members

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Branch Settings
docs.text: In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Settings → Branch

docs.title: Step 2: Select Branch
docs.text: Click to view the branch

docs.title: Step 3: Access Staff Shift Template Section
docs.text:
• In the Operating Hours section, locate the Staff Shift Template section
  • Click Create Template

docs.title: Step 4: Fill In Template Details
docs.text:
• Fill in the template information:
    • Name: Enter a descriptive name for the shift template
  • Use the time slider to set:
    • Available Times
    • Break Times

docs.title: Step 5: Save Template
docs.text:
• Click Add to create the template
  • Make sure to click the Save button in the bottom right corner

docs.title: Available Times
docs.text: • Set the shift pattern for staff

docs.title: Break Times
docs.text:
• Define break periods within the available times
  • Staff will not be available for appointments during break times
  • You can set multiple break periods if needed

docs.title: 📹 Video Tutorial
docs.text: Follow along in this short video to see exactly how it's done!

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up staff shift templates, proceed to: Setup Branch Room

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Staff Shift Template section: Ensure you're in the correct branch view and have admin permissions.

Time slider issues: Try refreshing the page and ensure break times are within available times.

Template not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and click the main "Save" button after creating templates.

Multiple branches: Create shift templates for each branch that has different operational needs.

docs.title: Setup Staff / Counsellors
docs.text: This guide will walk you through adding staff members to your scheduler system.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Staff members are the people who provide services to your customers. Each staff member can be assigned to specific services, branches, and can have specializations and skills associated with them.

docs.title: Step 1: Navigate to Staff Management
docs.text:
• In the left-hand side menu, navigate to Staffs → Staffs
  • Click Create Staff

docs.title: Step 2: Input Basic Staff Information
docs.text:
• Name: Enter the staff member's full name
  • Email: Enter the staff member's email address (used for notifications and login)
  • Branch: Select which branch the staff member works at

docs.title: Step 3: Input Specializations and Skills (Optional)
docs.text:
• Select Specializations: Choose from previously created specializations
  • Select Skills: Choose from previously created skills

docs.title: Step 4: Service Availability
docs.text: • Select Services: Choose which services the staff member can be booked for or leave as "All Services"

docs.title: Step 5: Save Staff Member
docs.text: • Click Create Staff to add the staff member

docs.title: 📹 Video Tutorial
docs.text: Follow along in this short video to see exactly how it's done!

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text: After setting up staff members, proceed to: Setup Staff Schedules

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Cannot see Staffs menu: Ensure you have admin permissions to access staff management.

Staff not saving: Verify all required fields are filled and try again.

No specializations/skills available: Complete the Specialization & Skills setup first (optional).

No services available: Complete the Service setup first.

Email already in use: Each staff member must have a unique email address.

Branch not available: Ensure the branch exists and is active.
